description: This file contains a PHP class definition for managing subscription statuses within the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting subscription status records, and handles interactions with models and views. The class extends the base controller and facilitates CRUD operations for subscription statuses with associated URL routing and permissions.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription status in the OpenCart admin interface. Handles CRUD operations, listing, and form processing for subscription statuses.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads language, title, and view for listing subscription statuses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to retrieve a list of subscription statuses with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates HTML view for the subscription status list with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a subscription status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to add or update a subscription status, returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscription statuses, returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to delete selected subscription status records, with permission and validation checks, and returns JSON response.
